title: Passage 27
voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

sentences.en: Do you yawn?
sentences.cn: 你打哈欠吗？

sentences.en: There are about 20 reasons that scientists think are possible for yawning after research.
sentences.cn: 经过研究，科学家们认为打哈欠有大约20种可能的原因。

sentences.en: They do not know exactly why yawning happens, but they do know many facts about yawning.
sentences.cn: 他们还不清楚打哈欠的确切原因，但对打哈欠的许多事实都有所了解。

sentences.en: Everyone yawns in the same way, from babies to adults.
sentences.cn: 从婴儿到成人，每个人打哈欠的方式都是一样的。

sentences.en: First you open your mouth slowly, like a sleepy lion.
sentences.cn: 首先，你会慢慢张开嘴，就像一头困倦的狮子。

sentences.en: Your mouth stays open for about five seconds.
sentences.cn: 你的嘴会保持张开状态大约五秒钟。

sentences.en: You take in a lot of air and then push it out.
sentences.cn: 你会吸入大量空气，然后再将其呼出。

sentences.en: Then you quickly close your mouth.
sentences.cn: 接着，你会迅速闭上嘴。

sentences.en: Yawning is contagious.
sentences.cn: 打哈欠是会传染的。

sentences.en: If you see someone yawn, your body may reply by yawning too, much like a secret way of communication.
sentences.cn: 如果你看到别人打哈欠，你的身体也可能会以打哈欠的方式回应，就像是某种秘密的交流方式。

sentences.en: Many people say they yawn because they are tired.
sentences.cn: 很多人说打哈欠是因为他们累了。

sentences.en: That might be true.
sentences.cn: 这可能是真的。

sentences.en: People do often yawn before they sleep and after they wake up or before breakfast.
sentences.cn: 人们确实经常在睡觉前、睡醒后或早餐前打哈欠。

sentences.en: However, people also yawn when they are excited or nervous.
sentences.cn: 然而，人们在兴奋或紧张时也会打哈欠。

sentences.en: Yawning doesn't just mean you are lazy.
sentences.cn: 打哈欠并不只是意味着你懒惰。

sentences.en: Yawning proves that your body needs to stay alert.
sentences.cn: 打哈欠表明你的身体需要保持警觉。

sentences.en: When you yawn, you breathe deeply.
sentences.cn: 当你打哈欠时，你会深呼吸。

sentences.en: You also stretch the muscles in your face, throat, neck and shoulders.
sentences.cn: 你还会拉伸面部、喉咙、颈部和肩部的肌肉。

sentences.en: Your eardrums stretch, too.
sentences.cn: 你的鼓膜也会得到拉伸。

sentences.en: Maybe this helps you to be quicker to notice things.
sentences.cn: 这或许有助于你更快察觉到周围的事物。

sentences.en: In some countries, people think yawning is not nice.
sentences.cn: 在一些国家，人们认为打哈欠不太好。

sentences.en: People put their hands over their mouths to cover a yawn,
sentences.cn: 人们会用手捂住嘴来遮掩自己的哈欠，

sentences.en: and we often do the same thing when we cough.
sentences.cn: 就像我们咳嗽时经常做的那样。

sentences.en: However, in other countries, people think yawning can let good things in.
sentences.cn: 而在另一些国家，人们则认为打哈欠可以带来好运。

sentences.en: Scientists do not spend much time studying yawning.
sentences.cn: 科学家们并没有花太多时间研究打哈欠。

sentences.en: That is probably because yawning does not hurt or cause any medical emergency.
sentences.cn: 这可能是因为打哈欠不会造成伤害或引发任何医疗紧急情况。

sentences.en: It is just a normal thing we do.
sentences.cn: 这只是我们做的一件平常事。
